features: We start with a giclee lithograph mounted on wood, and finish it with a texturized brush stroke finish. We didn't stop there though as we fit it within a 1. 5 inch thick ebony wood grain frame to add depth and dimension.
Ready to Hang - No Installation or Hardware Needed
description: First came wood, then came canvas, and now we introduce our 'Framed Giclee Textured Wall Art. ' 100% Made in USA as always, we start with a giclee lithograph mounted on wood, and finish it with a texturized brush stroke finish. We didn't stop there though as we fit it within a 1. 5 inch thick ebony wood grain frame to add depth and dimension. Ready to hang.
